reasoning: Evaluated Tools Page filters and CRUD UX interactions. Found partial implementation: Status and Category filters work (3/8 pts), but Department is commented out and cost range filter is missing entirely. Clear filters functionality is complete (2/2 pts). CRUD modals exist but lack smooth animations and focus management (1/3 pts). Edit properly pre-fills data (4/4 pts) and delete has safe confirmation (4/4 pts). Critical gaps: NO success/error feedback after CRUD operations (0/4 pts each) - mutations only close modal without toast/alert. Form validation UI is excellent with real-time Zod validation (3/3 pts). Total: 17/35 points (48.6%). Main issues: incomplete filters, missing user feedback system, no animations.
